headline: Our ube pandesal sells out before 10 a.m.
quote: Two drops of PURE Ube in every batch and the color and aroma come out right every time. Regulars ask for it by name now.
name: Marites Dela Cruz

headline: Three new milk-tea flavors in one week
quote: We tested lychee, matcha and mango side by side and launched all three. The concentrates mix clean into the base, no grainy bits.
name: Jun Reyes

headline: Frosting that tastes like real strawberries
quote: My buttercream finally tastes like the fruit, not like candy. A little goes a long way, so one bottle lasts me a month of orders.
name: Bea Santos
role: Home baker, Cakes by Bea, Cebu City

headline: Mango shakes our customers line up for
quote: Summer menu was all mango this year. Same taste in every cup, even when fresh mangoes are expensive or out of season.
name: Carlo Mendoza

headline: A cheesecake bar that tastes baked from scratch
quote: We use the cheesecake flavor in our no-bake bars and nobody believes it. Easy to reorder on cash on delivery, too.
name: Ana Villanueva

headline: Coffee drinks with a caramel finish, no syrup mess
quote: Swapping syrups for a few drops of caramel saved shelf space and cut our cost per cup. The baristas like it more too.
name: Paolo Garcia
